To,  
Listing Department 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited  
Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block G, Bandra Kurla 
Complex, Bandra (E), Mumbai - 400 051  
Symbol: ATLANTAELE 
                                                                        
Sub. :  Audio recording of Earnings Call for Q1FY27 held on 22nd July, 2026  
Ref. : 1. Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations 2015; and  
           2.  Intimation of Earnings Call dated 17th July, 2026

With reference to the Listing Regulations and aforesaid intimation thereunder, we wish 
to inform you that the audio recording of earnings call for analysts / investors held 
today i.e. 22nd July, 2026, is available on Company’s website at:  
 
https://aetrafo.com/assets/images/investor-relation/ragulation-2015/audio/earning-
call-q1fy27.mp3 
 
This is for your information and record. 
 
Thanking you, 
For Atlanta Electricals Limited
